urls.title: URLs or domains
urls.description: Up to 100 public websites. One homepage GET per site plus redirects and robots checks; duplicates removed.

renderJs.title: Render JavaScript
renderJs.description: Optional Chromium rendering and bounded reads of fingerprint global paths. Default false; requires more memory.

includeCategories.title: Include categories
includeCategories.description: Optional case-insensitive category names or numeric IDs as strings. Empty means all categories.

maxConcurrency.title: Concurrent sites
maxConcurrency.description: Runtime default 5 in HTTP mode; rendering is capped at 2.

timeoutSeconds.title: Per-site timeout
timeoutSeconds.description: Runtime default 45; includes fetch/render and matching.
